chitchat: thumbs a round out of the feed, inspects it, and slots it back.
"Out here you shoot what flies. Usually worth stripping when it comes down."
description: A leathery wastes gun-hand crouched behind a jury-rigged autocannon bolted to a dead truck bed, goggles pushed up on a sunburnt forehead.

bye.text: They turn back to the guns and the sky.

root.text: They keep one eye on the sky. "Unless you're here to help work the guns, you're in the way. Move."

name: a wastes gun-hand
